findings.title: text.blank? raises ArgumentError on malformed UTF-8 before text.scrub can clean it
findings.evidence: Both parse_text methods call `return '' if text.blank?` before `text.scrub`. ActiveSupport's blank? performs a regex match that raises on malformed input. Pre-existing pattern (affects body too).
findings.recommendation: No action — pre-existing, affects body identically, browsers always send valid UTF-8.

findings.title: QA harness starts Cypress server from main checkout, not worktree
findings.evidence: Seeded data reflects base branch code (no subject column in default templates). Feature-branch defaults must be tested via rails runner in the worktree.
findings.recommendation: Infrastructure improvement for qa-harness: allow configuring the server working directory.
